newsitem.title: USA: Rains miss central Illinios, Indiana - Smith Barney.
newsitem.headline: Rains miss central Illinios, Indiana - Smith Barney.

text.p: Weekend rains missed much of central and southern Illinois and western Indiana, leaving some areas badly in need of moisture, Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis said in his daily report.

"The heaviest, most concentrated rains fell in Ohio, northern and eastern Indiana and southern Wisconsin," Davis wrote. "The big loser in all of this is Illinois and western Indiana where the storms were quite scattered and amounts and coverage will be disappointing."
He said coverage for all of Illinois was around 40 percent, concentrated in the northern third.

"The main crop of concern at the present time is the corn where the driest areas of the state are definitely stressed," Davis wrote. "The sharply cooler temperatures this week will reduce heat stress as the corn continues to pollinate but the region is badly in need of getting a good, soaking rain."
